decided: A note in the plan that excuses a difference counts only if it was there when building began; one added later excuses nothing on its own, and counts only as the user's answer when that sensor is set to stop and the user answers its stop.
alternatives: let any note in the plan excuse a difference, whenever it was written
why: Otherwise a run could excuse its way past any sensor by writing the excuse after the fact.

defines.definition: A check orbit runs over the code, the change and its history that reports whether a run has gone off course.
The moment a change's building begins, after which its plan no longer changes; a sensor compares against the plan and settings as they stood then.
